training.eligibility: max(0,i-2000) <= j <= i-4; j % 4 != 0; finite features; exact same candidate pool for all models
training.refit: every observed bar, from scratch, including pre-evaluation context
training.features: unchanged f1..f5; existing causal normalization; no additional scaling or feature engineering
training.lorentzian: original 8-neighbor vote; probability vector is empirical class fraction among those 8, not calibrated
training.prior: empirical class frequencies in identical eligible pool; no features
training.single_class: logistic uses empirical prior if only one training class exists
training.forecast: sign(p_up-p_down); exact ties abstain and retain existing signal-state semantics

evaluation: v3 period 2024-01-01 to 2026-09-01 exclusive; score labels only when matured by data end; last unknown targets censored
probability_metric: multiclass Brier=sum_k (p_k-1[y=k])^2, including genuine flat; lower is better; no calibration claimed
primary_family: gold prior Brier minus logistic Brier
gold Lorentzian Brier minus logistic Brier
gold logistic minus prior monthly net R
gold logistic minus Lorentzian monthly net R
secondary: short and long precision and recall
balanced accuracy with abstention counted as missed class
matched original Lorentzian negative-vote and executed-short cohorts
coefficients sampled monthly not interpreted causally
runner: unchanged v3 runner and filter/state-change/kernel code; each model supplies its own signals including opposite-start exits; one position, 1 ATR stop, 1R activation/distance trail, no fixed TP, 24h cap
promotion: none; already-inspected history, no untouched holdout; all four adjusted primary lower bounds >0 required even for preliminary incremental support
forbidden: claim calibrated probabilities or untouched validation
infer no information exists from one failed learner
